title: Missing doc comments on articles_db public fns
description: All public functions in fieldwork-db/src/articles_db.rs (create_collection, get_collection, list_user_collections, update_collection, delete_collection, create_article, get_article, get_article_by_slug, list_collection_articles, list_user_articles, update_article, delete_article, increment_views, pin_article, unpin_article, move_to_collection) lack doc comments. The other db modules (books_db, audio_db, media_db) all have doc comments on their public functions. Standards require doc comments on all public items.
